cases.prompt: 이 Discord 공지를 옵시디언 노트 스타일로 정리해줘. 마감은 2026-07-27이고 멤버는 고범수, 장현서야. 데모 URL은 https://open2-beta.upstage.ai/
cases.expected_behavior: Body dates become [[2026-07-27]]; people become [[고범수]] and [[장현서]]; demo URL is inline [label](https://open2-beta.upstage.ai/) with no [^n] footnotes; hierarchical content uses nested tab bullets under ## / #### headings.

cases.prompt: Format this meeting note for Obsidian: Alice met Bob on 2026-08-01 about the launch, docs at https://example.com/docs
cases.expected_behavior: Uses [[2026-08-01]], [[Alice]]/[[Bob]] wikilinks (or equivalent person wikilinks), inline markdown link for the docs URL, no footnote definitions, compact body without blank lines around headings.

cases.prompt: Add a References section with the recording URL for this vault note
cases.expected_behavior: Uses ## References with standard [title](url) markdown links; still does not introduce body footnotes for web links.
